tips: Little League double plays are hard — the must-have out is the lead runner. Get that one first, then try for two.

why: The runner from 2nd will try to score. Throw home through the cutoff — if there's no play at home, the cutoff catches it and gets the batter trying for 2nd.
tips: Outfielders: throw it low and hard to the cutoff man’s chest — never to the wrong base.

C.job: Cover home — yell "Cut!" or let it come through

1B.job: Cutoff for the throw home — line up between the ball and home

2B.job: Cover 1st (the first baseman is the cutoff)

SS.job: Cover 2nd base

LF.job: Come in and back up 3rd base, deeper than the pitcher

RF.job: Charge the ball and throw home — hit the cutoff man

runnerMoves.note: Rounds 1st, looks to take 2nd on a throw home

headline: Throw home through the cutoff!
why: The runner from 2nd will try to score. Throw home through the cutoff — if there's no play at home, the cutoff catches it and gets the batter trying for 2nd.
tips: Outfielders: throw it low and hard to the cutoff man’s chest — never to the wrong base.

1B.job: Watch the batter touch 1st, then trail them toward 2nd — be ready to help in a rundown

SS.job: Relay man — run out toward the ball, arms up, and yell!

3B.job: Cover 3rd — keep the batter from a triple

CF.job: Chase it down and throw to the relay man

RF.job: Back up 2nd — line up behind the bag in case the relay man throws behind the batter (dotted line)

headline: Relay it to 3rd!
why: Nobody on, so the batter is thinking triple. Relay the ball to 3rd to hold them at 2nd.
tips: Small field = one relay man is enough — no trail man. The other middle infielder stays at 2nd so the batter can’t just walk into it.

tips: Small field = one relay man is enough — no trail man. The other middle infielder stays at 2nd so the batter can’t just walk into it.

P.job: Go halfway between 3rd and home in foul territory — read the throw, then back up that base

1B.job: Watch the batter touch 1st, then hustle to the cutoff spot in front of home

2B.job: Relay man — run out toward the ball, arms up, and yell!

SS.job: Cover 2nd base

LF.job: Come in and back up 3rd base, deeper than the pitcher

CF.job: Chase it down and throw to the relay man

RF.job: Back up the center fielder

tips: If the infield is playing in to stop the run, throw home to get the runner from 3rd instead.

headline: Throw to 1st!
why: Two outs — you only need ONE out to end the inning. Take the closest force play: 1st.
tips: If you are close to the bag, just step on it yourself. If not, flip to the pitcher covering.
With 2 outs, every runner takes off on contact.

tips: If the infield is playing in to stop the run, throw home to get the runner from 3rd instead.

tips: Runners: on a fly ball with less than 2 outs, go back and TAG your base. Leave when the ball is caught.

RF.job: Catch it, then throw to 2nd — hit the cutoff man

headline: Relay it to 3rd!
why: Nobody on, so the batter is thinking triple. Relay the ball to 3rd to hold them at 2nd.
tips: Big field = double cut. The relay man lines up with the outfielder, and the trail man ~30 feet behind shouts "Home! Home!" or "Three! Three!"

headline: Relay it home!
why: Runners will try to score on a ball in the gap. Use the relay: outfielder → relay man → home. Two short, strong throws beat one long, bouncing one.
tips: Big field = double cut. The relay man lines up with the outfielder, and the trail man ~30 feet behind shouts "Home! Home!" or "Three! Three!"

tips: Outfielders: throw it low and hard to the cutoff man’s chest — never to the wrong base.

1B.job: Watch the batter touch 1st, then follow them to 2nd and cover it (both middle infielders are out on the relay)

2B.job: Trail the relay man by ~30 feet — catch a bad throw and yell where it goes

SS.job: Relay man — run out toward the ball, arms up, and yell!

3B.job: Cover 3rd — keep the batter from a triple

CF.job: Chase it down and throw to the relay man

RF.job: Back up 2nd — line up behind the bag in case the relay man throws behind the batter (dotted line)

headline: Relay it to 3rd!
why: Nobody on, so the batter is thinking triple. Relay the ball to 3rd to hold them at 2nd.
tips: Big field = double cut. The relay man lines up with the outfielder, and the trail man ~30 feet behind shouts "Home! Home!" or "Three! Three!"

SS.job: Relay man — run out toward the ball, arms up, and yell!

CF.job: Chase it down and throw to the relay man

RF.job: Back up 2nd — line up behind the bag in case the relay man throws behind the batter (dotted line)

headline: Relay it home!
why: Runners will try to score on a ball in the gap. Use the relay: outfielder → relay man → home. Two short, strong throws beat one long, bouncing one.
tips: Big field = double cut. The relay man lines up with the outfielder, and the trail man ~30 feet behind shouts "Home! Home!" or "Three! Three!"
